name: Autoimmune Pancreatitis Type 2

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: International Consensus Diagnostic Criteria (ICDC) for Autoimmune Pancreatitis

criteria.description: Presence of granulocytic epithelial lesions on pancreatic histology
Imaging evidence of segmental or focal narrowing of the main pancreatic duct
Association with inflammatory bowel disease (especially ulcerative colitis)
Normal serum IgG4 levels (distinguishing from Type 1 AIP)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histological confirmation of granulocytic epithelial lesions plus imaging evidence of pancreatic duct narrowing
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Serum IgG4 levels are typically normal, differentiating from Type 1 autoimmune pancreatitis.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Granulocytic epithelial lesions on pancreatic biopsy
searchTerms: pancreatic tissue damage with immune cells

pathognomonic.symptomName: Segmental or focal narrowing of the main pancreatic duct
searchTerms: narrowing of parts of pancreatic duct

occasional.notes: Often related to associated inflammatory bowel disease

rare.symptomName: Diabetes mellitus secondary to pancreatic involvement
searchTerms: high blood sugar from pancreatic disease
elevated liver tests from bile flow problems

laboratory: Mildly elevated inflammatory markers (ESR, CRP) in some cases
Possible elevated liver enzymes if biliary involvement
imaging: Segmental or focal narrowing of the main pancreatic duct on MRCP or ERCP
Focal pancreatic enlargement or mass-like lesion on CT or MRI
Absence of diffuse pancreatic enlargement typical of Type 1 AIP
other: Histopathology showing granulocytic epithelial lesions without significant IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltration

distinguishingFeatures: IgG4-positive plasma cell infiltration on biopsy
Progressive pancreatic mass without response to steroids

redFlags: Failure to respond to corticosteroid therapy
references: Shimosegawa T, et al. International consensus diagnostic criteria for autoimmune pancreatitis: guidelines of the International Association of Pancreatology. Pancreas. 2011.
Chari ST, et al. Diagnosis of autoimmune pancreatitis: the Mayo Clinic experience. Clin Gastroenterol Hepatol. 2006.
Ghazale A, et al. Autoimmune pancreatitis: a systematic review. J Clin Gastroenterol. 2009.
